text: This year-end report provides an update to the Board on the final progress of the 2017 Capital Works Program. The 2017 Capital Works Program budget consists of two parts totalling $7,206,939: - The “state-of-good-repair” (SOGR) 2017 program for Exhibition Place with a budget of $4,390,000 (items 1 to 10 - Appendix 'A'); and - The 2016 total cash flow carry forward of $2,816,939 (items 11 to 16 - Appendix 'A'). A cash flow carry forward is defined in this report as the combination of unspent committed costs through signed contracts and agreements, and any surplus from the above program projects.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place received the report (March 8, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
